question: What may flash for one established in unity practice?
premises: One is established in unity practice.
The universe may suddenly flash by force.
It flashes like a dancer as full Shiva-nature.
inference: Unity practice can make the whole universe flash as full Shiva-nature.
plain_english: Thus for one established in unity-practice, this universe suddenly, by force, like a dancer, may flash as full Shiva-nature.
